measure.title: Desk placement for daylight
measure.description: Move twelve desks to the positions along the north-east glazing with the best daylight, low glare risk and good comfort. The lighting has no daylight control, so the saving depends on people switching lights off and is shown as a range from zero.

finance.cost_source: Zero cost by definition (SPEC.md section 6.4); physics 04 COST-01: 0 USD per desk layout x 1

notes: Paid in full at installation. First-year net cash flow is savings less the change in operation and maintenance; the investment is shown as net upfront cash (physics 04 ECO-12).
electricity escalation held at the N=10 value for N=5 (ECO-06 table covers 10 to 30)
gas escalation held at the N=10 value for N=5 (ECO-06 table covers 10 to 30)

Hypothetical: no official page names a programme, public agency or administrator that takes commercial PACE applications in the City or County of Los Angeles (specs/legal/california.md section 7.3, CA-PACE-15 and CA-PACE-16), so this scenario is not eligible until one is confirmed.
Nothing to finance: desk placement is not a permanent improvement fixed to the property.
Term shortened from 20 to 5 years: it may not exceed the useful life of the improvement (texas.md TX-PACE-11).

The assessment and any interest and penalties are a lien on the parcel until paid, collected with and in the same manner as the general property taxes (Streets and Highways Code 5898.30; specs/legal/california.md CA-PACE-10).
Existing mortgage holder: consent or acknowledgment is a programme and capital-provider requirement, not a California statutory condition (specs/legal/california.md section 7.6).

Statutory test for commercial property: annual property taxes plus assessments, with this one, may not exceed 5 percent of market value at approval (Streets and Highways Code 5898.15; CA-PACE-07). It cannot be completed without the market value and the tax bill.

measure.title: Rooftop solar, 44.72 kW
measure.description: 104 modules, 44.72 kW DC, about 69,381 kWh a year; kWh are netted at the energy price over the year.

finance.cost_source: TTS-2024 executive summary (small non-residential, under 100 kW), not CPI-adjusted; physics 04 COST-01: 3.35 USD per W DC x 44720

incentives.name: Federal clean electricity investment credit (26 U.S.C. 48E), business-owned solar
conditions: no material assistance from a prohibited foreign entity
owner is a taxpayer who can use the credit
incentives.citation: physics 04 INC-05: section 48E(a)(2)(A)(ii)(I), (b)(6), (e)(4)(A); Pub. L. 119-21 (139 Stat. 72), section 70513

notes: Paid in full at installation. First-year net cash flow is savings less the change in operation and maintenance; the investment is shown as net upfront cash (physics 04 ECO-12).

Term of 20 years does not exceed the useful life of 25 years: a programme rule for a new commercial assessment in California, not a statutory condition (CA-PACE-11).

Program SIR 1.42: undiscounted savings over the 20-year term divided by all assessment payments (physics 04 ECO-12b). California has no statutory SIR test; a programme may apply one, so the ratio is a screen only.
